verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a registrar that ships a web service, an API and an npx-distributed MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry or analytics opt-out for the site, API or MCP server. The community discussion of ID verification through Veriff is about identity checks, not usage tracking, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
